text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: service=runtime-inference | severity=high | event=multiple_short_pages fired -> https://pd.company/PD12345

ashley: acked. I'm on it. pinging devon for infra side.

devon: seeing repeated 5xx spikes on /v1/generate from the canary fleet, ~20s bursts every ~40s. graph: https://grafana.company/d/abc123

ashley: copy. can you tail the sidecar logs on canary-03? `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=sidecar -c sidecar --tail=200`

devon: running, grabbing last 2m -> lots of repeated `kv-cache-miss` lines and short OOM-suppression messages. snippet:
```
kv-cache: miss key-prefix=chat-0.1
memory: free=1.2G, threshold=1.1G -> suppressing alloc
runtime: request rejected: resource_quota_exceeded
```

sre-lead: hmm, looks like cold-KV churn. Any recent deploys?

ashley: no deploys in the last hour. Autoscale events? ops-sre?

ops-sre: autoscaler bumped pool up 2 nodes ~10m ago then scaled back down. Looks like instance churn overlapped with bursty traffic.

devon: I temporarily increased KV cache TTL for canary namespace: `redis-cli -h redis-canary ACL SETUSER ...` (config change). Observing reduced miss-rate on prometheus.

ashley: nice. PD still seeing repeated pages?

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD12345 -> acknowledged by ashley at 3591234575

devon: pages stopped for now, looks stabilised. request p50 latency back to baseline.

cs-bot: Notifying CS: potential customer-facing errors observed on canary endpoints. No escalations yet.

ashley: quick customer-impact check: I queried the error budget and traced a handful of failed requests to internal retries. No 500s surfaced on the public API edge for production tenants.

devon: running a short smoke loop across a few large sessions to confirm KV warmup is holding. `ab -n 200 -c 10 https://canary.company/v1/generate`

ashley: good. I'm going to silence PD for 30m to avoid pager storms while we monitor. documented steps in thread.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD12345 -> silence set by ashley for 30 minutes

ops-sre: adding note: we'll pin autoscaler min-size to +1 for canary pool for next 2 hours to avoid churn during observed traffic pattern.

ashley: handing off to devon for watch. I'm stepping off in 12 minutes; devon will escalate to sre-lead if pages resume.

devon: acknowledged handoff. I'll watch the dashboards for 30m and post follow-up if any regression.

sre-lead: thanks — please add a follow-up ticket to investigate root cause of caching TTL sensitivity + autoscaler interaction. set priority=P2.

ashley: created INC-4872 with notes and logs. tagging infra and runtime teams.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD12345 -> auto-resolved at 3591234921 (no further pages)

ashley: closing thread — minimal customer impact, root cause suspected autoscaler churn + cold KV warmup. follow-up ticket assigned. :white_check_mark:

devon: thumbs up. I'll drop a short postmortem doc in #postmortems if we see this again.

sre-lead: good job team.

ops-sre: FYI I'll keep the temporary autoscaler pin until tomorrow morning.

cs-bot: CS notified that there was no customer-visible outage.

ashley: thanks all.
